g.text: Stacked contributions use identical currents in the grown-tree optimum; panel scales differ.
Necessary per-role tests only — not physiological or matched-network validation.
Equipressure caps; 0D, other-role and root-boundary losses omitted.
Portal and hepatic venous budgets assume forward portal/venous arms.
